author: Bill Ferguson
name: selection2collection
description: Creates a temporary collection from the currently selected images by applying a functional tag that the collection module filters on.
description-extensive: This tool turns whichever photos you have selected into a temporary grouping you can quickly jump back to, without permanently organizing your library. The grouping disappears when you close darktable (unless you choose to keep it), and your images are never deleted. No extra software is needed.
